lines.en: label christmastwo13:
scene postphonething1
: Ahh! Never in my life have I felt so utterly useless!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！我这辈子从没觉得自己这么彻底没用！

lines.en: : All of that time spent studying conflict resolution meant absolutely nothing in the face of an actual conflict!
lines.zh: : 学了那么久的冲突解决，面对一场真正的冲突时却毫无意义！

lines.en: : Why do they teach you {i}anything{/i} at all if the application of it in the real world is so much different than how it is when you study it?!
lines.zh: : 如果现实中的应用和学习时的样子差这么多，那他们到底为{i}什么{/i}要教你这些东西？！

lines.en: : There there, Touka. It’s not your fault that Otoha doesn’t want her parents to know she’s tongue wrestling an emo chick. That’s not a conflict you could’ve solved.
lines.zh: : 好了好了，Touka。Otoha 不想让她父母知道她在和一个情绪少女舌吻，这不是你的错。这不是你能解决的冲突。

lines.en: : You did all you could at the time. And I’m right here with ya.
lines.zh: : 你当时已经尽力了。而且我还在这儿陪着你呢。

lines.en: : You seem troubled, Guardian. Is this due to the romantic spat we just witnessed? Or is it a further continuation of your interpersonal troubles with our teacher?
lines.zh: : 你看起来有心事，守护者。是因为我们刚刚目睹的那场情侣争吵？还是你和老师之间的人际烦恼在继续发酵？

lines.en: scene postphonething2
: Troubles with our teacher? Did something happen between you and Sensei, Molly?
lines.zh: : 和老师的烦恼？Molly，你和老师之间发生什么了吗？

lines.en: : You’re gonna have to roll for persuasion if you want me to talk about that, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你想让我谈这个的话，得先投一次说服检定，Touka。

lines.en: : I fail to see how rolling around would persuade anyone and I would much rather not get my clothes dirty. I have no idea when this floor was last vacuumed.
lines.zh: : 我看不出在地上打滚能说服谁，而且我很不想把衣服弄脏。我完全不知道这地板上次吸尘是什么时候。

lines.en: : Besides, I think all the stuff with me and Sensei is kind of...taken care of? Maybe?
lines.zh: : 再说，我觉得我和老师之间的事大概……已经解决了？也许吧？

lines.en: : At the very least, we seem to have narrowly avoided a bad ending.
lines.zh: : 至少，我们似乎是险之又险地避开了一个坏结局。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be over there trying to comfort Rin with Futaba and Sensei? I thought you guys were friends.
lines.zh: : 你不是该去那边和 Futaba、老师一起安慰 Rin 吗？我还以为你们是朋友。

lines.en: : We are. Sometimes. Not all the time. Right now, we’re...uhh...nemeses?
lines.zh: : 我们是的。有时候是。不总是。现在的话，我们是……呃……死对头？

lines.en: scene postphonething3
: Uhh...no. That’s not the right word. Let’s see here...uhh...
lines.zh: : 呃……不。这个词不对。让我想想……呃……

lines.en: : Okay, so...Rin is basically Lady Jaina Proudmoore and I’m Kael’Thas Sunstrider.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这么说吧……Rin 基本上就是 Jaina Proudmoore 女士，而我是 Kael’Thas Sunstrider。

lines.en: scene postphonething4
: Which basically makes Otoha the Lich King...
lines.zh: : 这么算的话，Otoha 基本上就是巫妖王……

lines.en: : Are these popular culture references? Should I know who these people are?
lines.zh: : 这些是流行文化梗吗？我应该知道这些人是谁吗？

lines.en: : No, Molly’s just a dork. But that’s why we love her.
lines.zh: : 不是，Molly 就是个书呆子。但这也正是我们爱她的原因。

lines.en: : Is that why you seem so uncomfortable, Guardian? Because you have been striding on the sun?
lines.zh: : 你看起来这么不自在，是因为这个吗，守护者？因为你一直在骄阳上阔步前行？

lines.en: scene postphonething5
: Huh? No. What? Kael’Thas never actually...ugh.
lines.zh: : 哈？不。什么？Kael’Thas 从来没真的……呃。

lines.en: : I just don’t think it would be smart for me to try and comfort Rin when she’s made it very apparent that me being around just makes her {i}more{/i} uncomfortable at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，既然 Rin 已经表现得很明显——我现在待在她身边只会让她{i}更{/i}不舒服——那我去安慰她就不太明智了。

lines.en: : That is so sad. If I had any friends, I would hope that they would come to me in my time of need, even if I’d been cross with them recently.
lines.zh: : 这太让人难过了。如果我有朋友的话，我会在我需要的时候希望他们来到我身边，哪怕我最近跟他们闹过别扭。

lines.en: scene postphonething6
: Yeah, well...I’m on my last life at this point, so I...have to be as careful as possible or everything will be all over for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……我现在已经是最后一条命了，所以我……必须尽可能小心，否则一切就都结束了。

lines.en: : But I guess that’s what I get for trying to speedrun love, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过我想，这就是我试图“速通爱情”的报应吧。

lines.en: : Will it disappoint you to hear that I don’t?
lines.zh: : 听到我听不懂，会让你失望吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. I’ve got bigger fae to fry right now.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。我现在有更大的“仙子”要炸。

lines.en: : I had no idea they were edible.
lines.zh: : 我不知道它们还能吃。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should look into crafting a new side dish to bring more customers in.
lines.zh: : 也许我该考虑研发一道新的配菜，好招揽更多客人。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t even wanna try, Molly? I can go over there with you if you want.
lines.zh: : 你确定不想试试吗，Molly？你想的话我可以陪你过去。

lines.en: : I’m not super close with Rin but I still don’t want her crying at a Christmas party. That’s like, one of the worst places for a person to cry. Right next to a petting zoo or, like...Chuck E’ Cheese.
lines.zh: : 我和 Rin 不算特别亲近，但我也不想让她在圣诞派对上哭。那可是最不适合人哭的地方之一。仅次于宠物动物园，或者……Chuck E’ Cheese。

lines.en: scene postphonething7
: The American pizza rat?! I love him! Oh, he’s absolutely splendid!
lines.zh: : 那只美国披萨鼠？！我爱死他了！哦，他简直棒极了！

lines.en: : I had seen videos when I was younger and my father went as far as having an actual restaurant replicated in the basement of our summer home.
lines.zh: : 我小时候看过视频，我父亲甚至让人在避暑别墅的地下室里复刻了一整家真正的餐厅。

lines.en: : You’ve got a friggin’ Chuck E’ Cheese at your summer home?!
lines.zh: : 你们的避暑别墅里居然有一家该死的 Chuck E’ Cheese？！

lines.en: : Of course! Well, one of them. But it’s one of the nicer summer homes we have.
lines.zh: : 当然！嗯，是其中一家。不过那也是我们比较好的避暑别墅之一。

lines.en: scene postphonething8
: Oh! There’s an idea! Perhaps we could lighten the mood by talking more about our family traditions? That certainly sounds a lot more fun than focusing on the sad things, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦！有了！也许我们可以通过多聊聊各自的家庭传统来活跃气氛？听起来总比一直盯着伤心事有趣多了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen has only had rats on several occasions and I have never once been excited to see them.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 只有过几次老鼠出没，而我从来没有一次是看到它们会兴奋的。

lines.en: : I struggle to believe that we can find a common ground if they are one of your key interests.
lines.zh: : 如果老鼠是你的主要兴趣之一，我很难相信我们能找到共同点。

lines.en: : But I would also like the Guardian to stop frowning, so I will agree to this conversation.
lines.zh: : 但我也很想让守护者不再皱眉，所以这场对话我同意了。

lines.en: : How rich do you have to be to have a restaurant in your basement?...
lines.zh: : 你得有多有钱，才能在地下室里开一家餐厅啊？……

lines.en: : I appreciate the gesture, but now I just feel like even more of a burden.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，但现在我反而觉得自己更像个负担了。

lines.en: : Not at all, Molly! I’d be over the moon to share some of my experiences with you.
lines.zh: : 一点也不，Molly！能和你分享我的经历，我开心都来不及。

lines.en: : I’d be thrilled too if I had an entire animatronic band to play music for me whenever I wanted.
lines.zh: : 如果我随时都能有一整支电子动画乐队为我演奏，我也会乐疯的。

lines.en: scene postphonething9
: What do you think, Kendo Princess?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，剑道公主？

lines.en: : I think about many different things. I’m not sure which one you are referring to right now.
lines.zh: : 我想的事情有很多。我不确定你现在指的是哪一个。

lines.en: : About if I should talk to Rin or just...stay in Shadowmeld until the party is over.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我该去和 Rin 说话，还是就这么……一直遁入暗影到派对结束。

lines.en: : I thought you believed the shadows were for cowards?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你认为阴影是给懦夫用的？

lines.en: : They are...
lines.zh: : 是给懦夫用的……

lines.en: : I guess this is just one of those times where I have to sit in a bush and figure out if I should try to finish a group quest on my own or if I should...wait for someone else to pull the mob and go in after them.
lines.zh: : 我想这只是那种时候——我得蹲在草丛里琢磨，是该自己一个人试着做完这个团队任务，还是……等别人先把怪拉过来，我再冲进去。

lines.en: : I see no harm in relying on others if you are unsure about the outcome of handling something on your own.
lines.zh: : 如果你不确定自己独自处理某件事的结果，依赖他人并没有什么坏处。

lines.en: : But I am also very bad at video games, so you should not feel obligated to listen to me.
lines.zh: : 不过我非常不擅长电子游戏，所以你不必觉得非听我的不可。

lines.en: : I don’t have any idea what’s being discussed right now, but let me just say how excited I am to finally be “one of the girls.”
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你们现在在聊什么，但我只想说，能终于成为“姐妹团的一员”，我真的好激动。

lines.en: scene postphonething10
: If you...don’t mind carrying me, I’ll happily group up with you for now. I just might wind up slowing you down a bit.
lines.zh: : 如果你……不介意带我的话，我很乐意现在和你组队。只是可能会拖你一点后腿。

lines.en: : The Guardian is quite light despite what she says. I have lifted her on multiple occasions so I can confirm this.
lines.zh: : 守护者尽管嘴上那么说，其实很轻。我抱起过她好几次，所以可以确认这一点。

lines.en: : Uhh...why exactly have you been lifting her up, Tsunecchi?
lines.zh: : 呃……你到底为什么一直抱她啊，Tsunecchi？

lines.en: : That is an excellent question, Green Onion.
lines.zh: : 这是个非常好的问题，青葱。

lines.en: : Are you gonna answer it?
lines.zh: : 你打算回答吗？

lines.en: : No.
scene postphonething11
: Uta, would you like to start? I can’t imagine anyone being able to lighten the mood even half as good as you.
lines.zh: : Uta，你愿意先开始吗？我实在想不出有谁能像你一样，把气氛活跃起来哪怕一半那么好。

lines.en: : Aww, shucks. That’s really kind of ya, Touka. But I don’t really have any fancy summer home traditions to share with everybody.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。你人真好，Touka。不过我可没什么高级的避暑别墅传统能跟大家分享。

lines.en: : No, no. I wouldn’t expect a member of the lower-middle class to have something as extravagant as that. I’m referring to what you and your family would do for Christmas.
lines.zh: : 不不。我本来也没指望一个中下阶层的成员能有什么那么奢华的东西。我说的是你和家人过圣诞节会做什么。

lines.en: : Did you have any traditions? Or...things that you looked forward to every year?
lines.zh: : 你们有什么传统吗？或者……每年都会期待的事情？

lines.en: scene postphonething12
: Hmm...not really, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 嗯……应该没有吧。

lines.en: : I know a lot of families are starting to get more into the whole western Christmas sorta thing, but my family just kinda treated it like any other day.
lines.zh: : 我知道现在很多家庭开始越来越流行那种西式圣诞，但我家基本就把它当成普通的一天。

lines.en: : Just with a lot more chicken and-
lines.zh: : 只不过多了很多鸡肉，然后——

lines.en: scene postphonething13
: Oh! Actually! There was a thing we’d do when I was younger, but I kinda grew out of it once I got to middle school.
lines.zh: : 哦！等等！其实我小时候倒是做过一件事，不过上了中学就不怎么做了。

lines.en: : So, there was this big pond near my house that used to freeze over every winter. And on days that it was {i}really{/i} cold, me and my big brother would go over there and play hockey with some of the other kids.
lines.zh: : 我家附近有个大池塘，每年冬天都会结冰。{i}特别{/i}冷的那些日子，我哥就会带我过去，和其他孩子一起打冰球。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess that’s more of a winter thing and less of a Christmas thing, but I’m contributing in my own...non-Christmassy way!
lines.zh: : 我是说……这大概更像是冬天的事，不是圣诞的事，但我用自己的……不太圣诞的方式在做贡献！

lines.en: : What is this “hockey” you speak of? I am not familiar with that word.
lines.zh: : 你说的这个“冰球”是什么？我没听过这个词。

lines.en: scene postphonething14
: Hockey is like...
lines.zh: : 冰球就是……

lines.en: : Okay, so you’ve got this stick. Right? And there’s this black puck thingy you put on the ice and just sort of whack around with your sticks. And if you whack it into the right place, you get a point.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你有这么一根球杆。对吧？然后有个黑色的“圆盘玩意儿”放在冰上，大家就用球杆把它抽来抽去。要是你把它抽进了正确的地方，就得分。

lines.en: : I’m surprised to hear someone as feminine as you would partake in such...traditionally masculine activities. My father would have never allowed something like that.
lines.zh: : 真没想到像你这么有女人味的人，会参加这种……传统上属于男性的活动。我父亲是绝对不会允许那种事的。

lines.en: scene postphonething15
: Oh, I was like...a huge tomboy when I was little.
lines.zh: : 哦，我小时候可是个……超级假小子。

lines.en: : I had short hair and no boobs and like, a lot of people thought I {i}was{/i} a boy since I was always hanging around my brother and his friends.
lines.zh: : 我留短发，没有胸部，而且因为总和哥哥还有他的朋友们混在一起，很多人都以为我{i}是{/i}男的。

lines.en: : Miku’s probably pretty close to how I was back then. But even she’s a little girlier than I was, I think.
lines.zh: : Miku 大概就跟我那时候差不多。不过我觉得她都比我稍微女孩子气一点。

lines.en: : Do you...have any pictures we could see? I’m having a tough time imagining you like that, and imagining stuff is kinda my thing.
lines.zh: : 你……有没有照片能给我们看看？我很难想象你那个样子，而想象什么的可是我的强项。

lines.en: scene postphonething16
: Hahah...hah...uhh...no...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……呃……没有……

lines.en: : No, I don’t have anything like that...
lines.zh: : 不，我没有那种东西……

lines.en: : How about you, Tsuneyo? Did your family have any Christmas traditions?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Tsuneyo？你家里有什么圣诞传统吗？

lines.en: : I did not fully understand what Christmas was until recently, so I do not think so.
lines.zh: : 我直到最近才完全理解圣诞节是什么，所以应该没有。

lines.en: : There have been days in the past where our restaurant was busier than normal, though. So it is possible that Christmas was simply one of those.
lines.zh: : 不过过去有些日子我们店会比平时忙。所以圣诞节可能只是那样的日子之一。

lines.en: : From what I understand, this holiday is meant to be a time for significant others to spend with one another. And no one has ever been significant enough to become my other.
lines.zh: : 据我所知，这个节日是给恋人们彼此相伴的日子。而从来没有人重要到能成为我的“另一半”。

lines.en: : Therefore, Christmas is just another day. And another day means another chance to advertise the authentic tonkotsu ramen made by the Tojo family.
lines.zh: : 因此，圣诞节就只是又一天。而又一天意味着又一次机会，可以宣传 Tojo 家正宗的豚骨拉面。

lines.en: : Please come by if you ever want to warm your body and your heart.
lines.zh: : 如果你想温暖身体和心灵，随时欢迎光临。

lines.en: : Well, that wasn’t exactly what I was expecting. But I suppose we all have our own ways of celebrating.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可不太是我预料中的答案。不过我想，每个人都有自己庆祝的方式吧。

lines.en: scene postphonething17
: The Kendo Princess comes from a realm known to very few human beings where “tradition” carries a different sort of meaning.
lines.zh: : 剑道公主来自一个鲜为人知的领域，在那里“传统”的含义截然不同。

lines.en: : She is not familiar with the cultures of us normal people and it is our duty to cultivate and educate her so that she may, one day, finally fit in.
lines.zh: : 她不熟悉我们普通人的文化，而我们有责任去培养和教导她，好让她有一天终于能融入进来。

lines.en: : Is it just me or does that explanation sound a little silly coming from someone else who comes from a totally different world? And I don’t just mean the potato paradise.
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的问题，还是从一个同样来自完全不同世界的人嘴里说出这番解释，听起来有点蠢？我说的可不只是那个“土豆天堂”。

lines.en: scene postphonething18
: Hey! That “totally different” world knows a lot more about Christmas than this one does!
lines.zh: : 嘿！那个“完全不同”的世界可比这个世界懂圣诞节多了！

lines.en: : Except we called it Nollaig and Daidí na Nollag was the one who brought us presents...and it may or may not have also involved killing birds and carrying them around at one point.
lines.zh: : 只不过我们管它叫 Nollaig，给我们送礼物的是 Daidí na Nollag……而且其中可能还涉及杀鸟、拎着鸟到处走什么的。

lines.en: : Noodles, attack.
lines.zh: : 面条，攻击。

lines.en: : Caw!
lines.zh: : Caw!

lines.en: scene postphonething19
: I had no idea the Irish were such violent people.
lines.zh: : 我不知道爱尔兰人这么暴力。

lines.en: : Only when they’re drunk.
lines.zh: : 只有喝醉的时候。

lines.en: : Which probably doesn't mean much to you because of stereotypes and...my history at Halloween parties...
lines.zh: : 这话对你来说大概没什么意义，因为有刻板印象，还有……我在万圣节派对上的黑历史……

lines.en: : But I am completely sober this time! And will likely remain that way for the indefinite future in an attempt to not ruin any more friendships!
lines.zh: : 但这次我完全是清醒的！而且很可能会无限期地保持下去，以求不再毁掉更多友谊！

lines.en: : So did you like, kill birds every Christmas, Molly? Was that your family’s tradition?
lines.zh: : 所以你以前每个圣诞都会，怎么说，杀鸟吗，Molly？那是你们的家庭传统？

lines.en: scene postphonething20
: What? No. That wasn’t really ever a thing we did. It’s just one of the origins of how the holiday worked there. No one does it anymore.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我们从来没真的那么做过。那只是那个节日在那边的起源之一。现在没人这么干了。

lines.en: : So your tradition was {i}not{/i} killing birds. I’m afraid I can not relate to that one either on account of the many chickens that have died by my hand.
lines.zh: : 所以你的传统{i}不是{/i}杀鸟。恐怕这一条我也没法产生共鸣，因为死在我手里的鸡可不在少数。

lines.en: scene postphonething21
: The real tradition was just spending time with my family. Which I can’t really do anymore, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 真正的传统只是和家人待在一起。不幸的是，现在我做不到了。

lines.en: : So Christmas is kind of sad when I start thinking about how it used to be.
lines.zh: : 所以一想到以前的样子，圣诞节就有点伤感。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m starting to think that all traditions are kind of just...temporary.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我开始觉得，所有传统大概都只是……暂时的。

lines.en: : Not just Christmas, but stuff like...movie nights or...raid nights or...any other night where you’re supposed to get together and {i}do the thing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不只是圣诞节，还有像……电影之夜啊……开荒之夜啊……或者任何一个大家聚在一起{i}“做那件事”{/i}的夜晚。

lines.en: : As soon as one person can’t do it anymore, the entire thing falls apart and you’re just left with memories of how things used to be.
lines.zh: : 只要有一个人做不下去了，整件事就散了，你只剩下“以前是什么样”的回忆。

lines.en: scene postphonething22
: So you keep chasing after those memories by making new traditions and hoping that they’ll carry on forever.
lines.zh: : 于是你就不断追逐那些回忆，制造新的传统，希望它们能永远延续下去。

lines.en: : But none of them ever do.
lines.zh: : 但没有一个能永远延续。

lines.en: : And the next thing you know, you’re standing in a group of people you barely even know.
lines.zh: : 然后不知不觉间，你就站在一群你几乎不认识的人中间。

lines.en: : But maybe that will become a tradition of its own?
lines.zh: : 但也许这本身会变成一种传统？

lines.en: : I guess there’s...no way of ever really...
lines.zh: : 我猜……永远都没办法真的……

lines.en: scene postphonething23
: S-Sorry! I just rewatched one of my favorite anime series and now I’m stuck feeling all melancholic and stuff.
lines.zh: : 抱——抱歉！我只是重看了一遍我最喜欢的某部动画，现在整个人都陷在多愁善感里了。

lines.en: : But that’s enough about Nollaig! How is Christmas for you...Artificer of...Affluence?
lines.zh: : 不过 Nollaig 就聊到这儿吧！你的圣诞节是什么样的……富贵……工匠？

lines.en: : I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : The Guardian assigns new names to everyone. It appears the time has come for you to learn yours.
lines.zh: : 守护者会给每个人起新名字。看来是时候让你知道你的了。

lines.en: scene postphonething24
: Ah! Inclusion! I’m happy to be this...artifact person if that means I’m getting a cool girl nickname!
lines.zh: : 啊！被接纳了！能得到一个酷女孩的绰号，我很乐意当这个……工匠什么的！

lines.en: : “Cool girl” nickname might be a bit of a stretch, but...
lines.zh: : “酷女孩”的绰号可能有点勉强，不过……

lines.en: scene postphonething25
: Christmas for the Tsukiokas...
lines.zh: : Tsukioka 家的圣诞节嘛……

lines.en: : Well, similar to Uta- though in a significantly more effeminate manner, Father used to take me ice skating every Christmas.
lines.zh: : 嗯，和 Uta 有点像——只不过方式要阴柔得多——以前每年圣诞父亲都会带我去滑冰。

lines.en: : There were no sticks or...“black puck thingies,” but there was music and...bright lights and...all sorts of beautiful things.
lines.zh: : 没有球杆，也没有那些“黑色的圆盘玩意儿”，但有音乐，有……明亮的灯，还有各种各样美丽的东西。

lines.en: scene postphonething26
: My mother was absolutely wonderful at it as well. I always thought it was amazing the way she would move around the ice.
lines.zh: : 我母亲也非常擅长滑冰。我一直觉得她在冰上滑行的样子特别美。

lines.en: : It was as if she were dancing.
lines.zh: : 就像是在跳舞。

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} pretty amazing since I’ve seen what she’s packing and even {i}mine{/i} slow me down sometimes.
lines.zh: : 那可{i}真{/i}厉害，我可是见识过她的“装备”的，连{i}我的{/i}都会时不时拖我后腿。

lines.en: : That...okay. That was not something I...okay.
lines.zh: : 这……好吧。这话我……好吧。

lines.en: : Regardless, Christmas is one of the few times I can look back on and remember where she had a genuine smile on her face. Not just the polite one she’s always sporting today.
lines.zh: : 无论如何，圣诞节是为数不多能让我回想起来、记得她脸上挂着真诚笑容的时刻。而不是她现在老是挂着的那副礼貌性的笑。

lines.en: scene postphonething27
: Which isn’t to say she isn’t a happy person. I mean, why {i}wouldn’t{/i} she be?  We have everything we could ever want.
lines.zh: : 这并不是说她不幸福。我是说，她有什么理由{i}不{/i}幸福呢？我们想要的一切都有了。

lines.en: : But she just seemed so much more...free during those times. And it made {i}me{/i} feel free as well seeing her that way.
lines.zh: : 只是那些时候的她看起来要……自由得多。而看到她那个样子，{i}我{/i}也觉得自己自由了。

lines.en: scene postphonething28
: It’s been quite some time since I’ve been able to see that side of her, but I’d love to see it again one day.
lines.zh: : 我已经很久没看到她那一面了，不过我希望能有朝一日再见到。

lines.en: : But I suppose it’s like Molly said in her melodramatic rant moments ago-
lines.zh: : 但我想，就像 Molly 刚才那番夸张的感慨说的那样——

lines.en: : Sometimes, traditions simply come to an end and there is nothing we can do to bring them back.
lines.zh: : 有时候，传统就是走到了尽头，我们无能为力，无法把它们带回来。

lines.en: scene postphonething29
: Okay, okay. I know what this calls for.
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦。我知道现在该做什么了。

lines.en: : Hm? Know what {i}what{/i} calls for, exactly?
lines.zh: : 嗯？该做什么，具体是指{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene postphonething30
: Another tradition, obviously!
lines.zh: : 当然是再立一个传统啊！

lines.en: : Look at us, four random girls just standing in a room together, sharing our pasts with each other...ain’t this some sorta great bonding experience?
lines.zh: : 看看我们，四个随随便便凑到一起的女孩，站在一个房间里，互相分享各自的过去……这不就是某种很棒的增进感情的经历吗？

lines.en: : The Kendo Princess and I are roommates, though. I don’t know if I’d call us-
lines.zh: : 不过我和剑道公主是室友。我不知道这算不算——

lines.en: : Molly, you two are weird enough that you’d still be random even if you’d lived together for years.
lines.zh: : Molly，你们俩古怪到就算住在一起好几年，也照样称得上“随随便便”。

lines.en: : But I’m {i}saying{/i} that next year, if we have another one of these party thingies, we should do this again!
lines.zh: : 但我是{i}说{/i}，如果明年我们再办这种派对，我们应该再来一次！

lines.en: : I think this idea sounds lovely, but how can you be so sure that we’ll be able to do something like this again next year? What if the four of us are separated into new classes?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个主意很棒，可你怎么能这么肯定我们明年还能做这样的事？万一我们四个被分到新的班里了呢？

lines.en: scene postphonething31
: Fate, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是命运。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo? Are you finally tapping into the spirit realm?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？你终于接上灵界了？

lines.en: : Have you had the ability to predict the future all along? Why didn’t you ever tell me?
lines.zh: : 你一直都有预知未来的能力？为什么从来没告诉过我？

lines.en: : I know not what the future holds apart from noodles, but I do know that this “tradition” is one that will not die so easily.
lines.zh: : 除了面条，我不知道未来会怎样，但我知道这个“传统”不会那么容易消亡。

lines.en: : But {i}how{/i} can you know such-
lines.zh: : 可你{i}怎么{/i}知道这种——

lines.en: : Shh! Let her finish! It ain’t every day that Tsuneyo goes into the spirit realm!
lines.zh: : 嘘！让她说完！Tsuneyo 进入灵界可不是每天都有的事！

lines.en: : No matter who is involved, the cycle will continue.
lines.zh: : 无论牵涉到谁，这个循环都会继续下去。

lines.en: scene black
: Life is like a slice of chashu- mostly circular, but with various bumps and grooves along the way.
lines.zh: : 人生就像一片叉烧——大体是圆的，但一路下来有各种凸起和沟槽。

lines.en: : If you trace it with your finger, you’ll always wind up back at the same place you started.
lines.zh: : 如果你用手指沿着它描，最后总会回到你出发的那个地方。

lines.en: : Perhaps this meeting is our chashu. Perhaps we just need to experience the bumps and grooves before we meet again.
lines.zh: : 也许这次相遇就是我们的叉烧。也许我们只是需要先经历那些凸起和沟槽，才能再次重逢。

lines.en: : And perhaps-
lines.zh: : 也许——

lines.en: : That same thing is happening to someone else, somewhere we can’t see tonight...
lines.zh: : 同样的事，也正在某个我们今晚看不见的地方，发生在别人身上……
